items.title: Ed Garland Interview, 1957-04-16
items.q: So I said, Silvio, you want to work with it? Sure.

ctx.x: Was it hard to find a piano player at the time?

No, I got a hold of Lil. It wasn't hard. So Lil said, yeah, I'll go play with you. We went to play for a Chinese restaurant, along the west side. So the man gave me the job he liked bad. He said, I could have this job. So I said, Silvio, you want to work with it? Sure. I said, what do you want to tell Mrs. Jones? I ain't stood by Mrs. Jones.
Oh, yeah. I said, well, what do you want to tell your mother? Well, I'll tell her I'm playing someone for a church affair.
